name: Discipline
description: Short, punchy lines about consistency and effort. Good for 7–15s reels.

quotes.text: Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
quotes.author: Will Durant

quotes.text: The successful warrior is the average man with laser-like focus.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.text: You will never always be motivated. You have to learn to be disciplined.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Small disciplines repeated with consistency every day lead to great achievements.
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: The pain of discipline weighs ounces. The pain of regret weighs tons.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Suffer the pain of discipline or suffer the pain of regret.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Nothing will work unless you do.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.text: Do the hard things first and the day gets easier.
quotes.author: Unknown

quotes.text: Motivation gets you started. Habit keeps you going.
quotes.author: Jim Ryun
